description: This file defines the IUSBMassStorage interface for managing USB mass storage devices, including device info, mount info, partition info, and notifications within the WPEFramework project.

classes.name: IUSBMassStorage
classes.description: Interface for USB mass storage device management, including device enumeration, mount points, partition info, and event notifications.

classes.name: IUSBMassStorage::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for device mounted and unmounted events.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB mass storage events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently mounted USB storage devices.

methods.name: GetMountPoints
methods.description: Retrieves mount point information for a specified device.

methods.name: GetPartitionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves partition information for a given mount path.
